title: Property Coverage
description: Experimental in AdCP 3.3: sellers emitting this object MUST list media_buy.property_coverage in experimental_features on get_adcp_capabilities, and it MAY change between 3.x releases with notice per docs/reference/experimental-status. Declares whether a product's publisher_properties[] is an exhaustive coverage boundary. Absence of this object on a product means disclosure is `complete`: it never means `undisclosed`, so an omitted roster is never silently opaque. Disclosure and targetability are orthogonal: property_targeting_allowed and overlay_support describe what buyers may select, while disclosure describes what the seller tells buyers about the roster. An `undisclosed` product cannot offer inclusion targeting over properties it does not name. A network or operator domain MUST NOT stand in for third-party publisher properties; list only properties whose publisher-owned adagents.json authorizes the selling agent. Actual delivered properties are reported separately at delivery time. On request-bound discovery responses, sellers MUST return a partial or undisclosed product only when the request declares adcp_version 3.3 or later, because earlier buyers read a partial list as exhaustive and reject an empty roster. Consumers MUST treat an unrecognized disclosure value as undisclosed. See the property coverage section of the media-products reference.
